name: roxy
description: A machine your agent edits video on. Ask your coding agent to edit a video, make a TikTok, add captions or render a Remotion project: it uploads the footage to a roxy box with ffmpeg and many CPUs, cuts and renders there, and sends you a link to review the cut.

interface.shortDescription: Edit video on a remote machine, from your agent.
interface.longDescription: A machine your agent edits video on. Ask your coding agent to edit a video, make a TikTok, add captions or render a Remotion project: it uploads the footage to a roxy box with ffmpeg and many CPUs, cuts and renders there, and sends you a link to review the cut.
defaultPrompt: Edit the video in ./footage into a first cut.
Make three TikToks out of this podcast episode.
Add word-by-word captions to demo.mov and send me a link.
